envelope.description: Helper division and assembly: parts, combine, adapters, terminal precedence

body.title: Helper division and assembly: parts, combine, adapters, terminal precedence
body.summary: Build the division layer on the call layer: serial parts with division up to three times, the staged combine of N into ceil(N/g) with the per-part fallback ('combine' in notCovered), assembly adapters for the bundle and the aggregate, per-block unadmittable handling that keeps covered parts, and the terminal precedence (HandlingBudgetError only when every uncovered part is unadmittable, else model-failed or invalid-answer) with partFailures and bounded causes.
acceptanceChecks: terminal precedence follows the stated rule across unadmittable, call-failed and invalid-reply parts
a failed part is kept out, the others are kept, a combine failure returns the per-part results with 'combine' in notCovered, and a successful part is never discarded
a mixed request with one oversized-envelope block and admissible blocks returns the covered parts with the oversized block in notCovered
a single-pass call keeps the legacy route with the original error as cause

tests.name: partition-combine.test.ts: serial parts, division up to three times, repair exhaustion never discards a successful part, combine terminates and a combine failure returns per-part results with 'combine' in notCovered
partition-combine.test.ts: terminal precedence by cause (unadmittable, invalid-reply, call-failed) with partFailures kinds and cause chains
partition-combine.test.ts: bundle and aggregate adapters keep evidence layers and findings exactly through several combine stages
partition-combine.test.ts: mixed oversized-envelope and admissible blocks return the covered parts with the oversized block in notCovered

shared-context.test.ts: adherence regression with rule and code sites forced into separate parts, rule in every part and combine call, every site classified; a rule too large gives HandlingBudgetError naming the reference context
dependency-table.test.ts: capability and code regressions with forced partitions and deduped Related modules, Related docs and surface
provider-failure-kinds.test.ts: Vibe outage on every part of a divided call gives typed model-failed with no prefix; malformed Vibe reply gives invalid-answer
